0.0: I'm Robinson. I'm a pilot for Omega Sector's transport corps. Aliens attacked me while I was transporting a super important shipment, and I couldn't shake them. One crash later, here I am.
0.1: I wasn't hurt in the crash, so I jumped ship and tried to swim away. That's when the typhoon came. I have no idea how long that thing whipped me around, but the next thing I knew I was laid out on the beach here. I was tired and hungry and beaten all up by the storm, so I sent that SOS out with the last of my strength.
0.2: I never thought I'd be so happy to see a crazy-looking stranger. Please help me. I've got to get back to Omega Sector, but I don't even know where I am. Please tell my commanders what happened to me and get them to send a rescue team.
0.3: Here's my ID. You're literally saving my life right now.

0.msg: #b(Deliver Robinson's ID to Kenta in Aquarium and ask him to send a rescue team.)#k

no.0: Are you going to leave me here? Alone in this island? Please help me...

1.0: Hey, what's up? I'm a bit busy right now...

yes.0: What? You found a castaway? Is this his ID? Well, let me take a look at it. Oh, he's from Omega Sector. We've got an agreement with them. Don't worry, I'll take care of this guy.

item.0: Hello there. Can I help you? As you can see, I'm really busy right now. Please don't bother me unless it's something important.

lost.0: Omega Sector will send a rescue team only if you show them my ID. Please don't lose it!\r\n#b(Omega Sector is really far from here... Maybe Kenta in Aquarium can help instead.)#k

QuestInfo.name: [Aqua Road] Robinson's ID
QuestInfo.1: You met Robinson on a deserted island in the middle of the ocean. He's a pilot with Omega Sector, but got shot down by aliens. He needs to get back to Omega Sector, only he has no idea where he is right now. He's badly injured, too. If anyone ever needed help, it's him.\r\n\r\n#b(Take Robinson's ID to Kenta in Aquarium and ask for help.)#k
QuestInfo.2: Kenta wants you to explain the location of the deserted island.
